# Mindlox AI

> Mindlox AI provides AI-powered Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and autonomous medical billing automation designed to eliminate revenue leakage, accelerate claims processing, and optimize financial performance for healthcare organizations.

## Core Platform & Technology
- [Why Mindlox AI](https://www.mindlox.ai/why-mindlox-ai): Overview of autonomous RCM, AI workflow automation, and practice ROI.
- [Technology](https://www.mindlox.ai/technology): AI engine architecture, claim scrubbing automation, and integration models.
- [Solutions](https://www.mindlox.ai/solutions): Tailored RCM solutions for medical groups, specialty practices, and billing organizations.
- [Services Overview](https://www.mindlox.ai/services): Comprehensive list of end-to-end medical billing and RCM services.

## Interactive Demos & ROI Calculators
- [Revenue Leakage Calculator](https://www.mindlox.ai/revenue-leakage-calculator): Interactive tool to estimate practice revenue loss and recovery potential.
- [AI vs Human RCM Demo](https://www.mindlox.ai/demos/ai-human): Side-by-side comparison of AI automation vs traditional manual billing.
- [Command Center Demo](https://www.mindlox.ai/demos/command-center): Real-time analytics, claim monitoring, and operational dashboard demo.
- [Revenue Engine Demo](https://www.mindlox.ai/demos/revenue-engine): Automated claim lifecycle engine from generation to clearinghouse.
- [Billing Department Demo](https://www.mindlox.ai/demos/billing-department): Overview of full-service autonomous billing department execution.
- [Revenue Leakage Demo](https://www.mindlox.ai/demos/revenue-leakage): Interactive analysis of common leakage points in healthcare RCM.

## Key RCM Services
- [AR Recovery & Denial Management](https://www.mindlox.ai/ar-recovery): Automated follow-ups, denial appeals, and aged AR resolution.
- [AI Medical Coding](https://www.mindlox.ai/medical-coding): Autonomous CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS coding and compliance verification.
- [Provider Credentialing](https://www.mindlox.ai/credentialing): Provider enrollment, payer re-credentialing, and contracting management.
- [Payment Posting](https://www.mindlox.ai/payment-posting): Automated ERA/EOB posting, denial detection, and patient balance allocation.

## Specialty Solutions
- [Cardiology Billing](https://www.mindlox.ai/specialties/cardiology): Specialty-specific coding and billing workflows for cardiology practices.
- [Dermatology Billing](https://www.mindlox.ai/specialties/dermatology): Specialized billing for diagnostic procedures, path labs, and cosmetic modifiers.
- [Orthopedics Billing](https://www.mindlox.ai/specialties/orthopedics): Surgical coding automation and global period tracking for orthopedic practices.
- [Anesthesiology Billing](https://www.mindlox.ai/specialties/anesthesiology): Base/time unit calculation, concurrency management, and claim scrubbing.
